facts.fact: Neela's nape trigger comes from the Resin House forced turning: the hunters dropped an iron ring on its chain over her nape while the paddle worked resin onto her throat. A hand at the back of her neck means being led; Devan's no longer makes her stiffen.
At the roll Devan asks Neela aloud to write the line for him; she answers 'Ask, and I do it', first public use of the new bargain. Madhavi and Kandan remark that he asked.
